summary: Operator site (Wix) confirms 24 sites (17 pull-through, 5 back-in, 2 tent, all 30/50 A, water, sewer), laundry, dump, WiFi/cable, phone-only reservations at 912-437-2441 (matches). No rate posted anywhere by the operator; RV Life reviewers paid $50-55 a night (2025-2026). Directory-only military discount cleared. Pin matches Google (10 m). AWH's 'RVLife 9.4/10' line dropped as redundant with rating.
flags: Long-stay character, no posted nightly rate (test 2): RV Life reviewers write 'The park is set up with mostly permanent residence' (May 2025) and 'A lot of full timers' (February 2026). The operator posts no nightly price, so under the long-stay tests this fails test 2 even though overnighters are taken (reviews of 1-night and 1-week stays, 2025-2026). A human decides.

Price gate, for the human: camper reports on RV Life are $50 a night (February and April 2026), $51 and $55 (May 2025) - at or just over the US$50 line. Camper reports can't price this entry because the operator has a website. No gateway within 40 km (Savannah 82 km); the family has not stayed here. RV Life tier is $$ (avg $37).

Waterfront re-audit lead: stored 'not waterfront'. Imagery shows a ~1.5 ha pond directly against the west side of the RV loop (the west-row sites back onto it); the operator mentions only 'beautiful views'. Cat Head Creek itself is the wooded drainage to the south, not visible from the sites.
Email: the site's mailto link is catheadcreek@gmail.com but the contact block reads catheadcreekrvpark@gmail.com.
